subject: Creativity
title: Radiohead's OK Computer: Rock Meets the Digital Apocalypse
description: A quick win: understand Radiohead's OK Computer: Rock Meets the Digital Apocalypse.

hook.text: In 1997, Radiohead predicted digital alienation, surveillance anxiety, and AI dread — all set to guitar music.

buildup.text: OK Computer fused rock with electronic textures, unconventional song structures, and lyrics about technology's alienation.

discovery.text: They recorded in a mansion with vintage gear AND cutting-edge digital tools — merging analog warmth with digital.

twist.text: Critics expected them to repeat The Bends' guitar-rock formula.

climax.text: It influenced every 'art-rock' album since — Muse, Coldplay, Arcade Fire all trace their sonic DNA back to OK Computer.

punchline.text: They made an album about losing humanity in the digital age.

quiz.question: What themes did OK Computer explore that were ahead of its time?
